Rédime me, Dómine, * Et miserére mei.

content.english: ℟. Redeem me, O Lord, * and have mercy on me.

segments.t: Rédime me, Dómine, * Et miserére mei.

content.english: ℣. For my feet stood in the right way.

segments.t: Pes enim meus stetit in via recta.

content.english: ℟. And have mercy on me.

segments.t: Rédime me, Dómine, * Et miserére mei.

content.latin: ℣. Ab occúltis meis munda me, Dómine.
content.english: ℣. From my secret ones cleanse me, O Lord.

segments.t: Ab occúltis meis munda me, Dómine.

content.latin: ℟. Et ab aliénis parce servo tuo.
content.english: ℟. And from those of others spare thy servant.

segments.t: Et ab aliénis parce servo tuo.

content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Præsta, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut observatiónes sacras ánnua devotióne recoléntes, et córpore tibi placeámus, et mente.
content.english: Grant, we beseech thee, O Almighty God, that we who every year do earnestly renew the sacred observance of this Fast, may please thee both in body and in soul.

content.latin: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Through Jesus Christ, thy Son our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

content.english: ℣. Let us bless the Lord.

content.english: ℣. May the souls of the faithful, through the mercy of God, rest in peace.

segments.t: Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.

content.english: ℟. Amen.

content.english: ℣. O God, ✠ come to my assistance;

segments.t: Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.

content.latin: ℟. Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.
content.english: ℟. O Lord, make haste to help me.

segments.t: Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.

content.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

content.english: Alleluia.

content.latin: Ant. Dómine, * probásti me et cognovísti me. ‡
content.english: Ant. Lord, * thou hast proved me, and known me. ‡

segments.t: Ant.
Dómine, * probásti me et cognovísti me.
Psalmus 138(1-13)

content.latin: 138:1 Dómine, probásti me, et cognovísti me: * ‡ tu cognovísti sessiónem meam, et resurrectiónem meam.
content.english: 138:1 Lord, thou hast proved me, and known me: * ‡ thou hast known my sitting down, and my rising up.

segments.t: Dómine, probásti me, et cognovísti me: *
tu cognovísti sessiónem meam, et resurrectiónem meam.

content.latin: 138:3 Intellexísti cogitatiónes meas de longe: * sémitam meam, et funículum meum investigásti.
content.english: 138:3 Thou hast understood my thoughts afar off: * my path and my life thou hast searched out.

segments.t: Intellexísti cogitatiónes meas de longe: * sémitam meam, et funículum meum investigásti.

content.latin: 138:4 Et omnes vias meas prævidísti: * quia non est sermo in lingua mea.
content.english: 138:4 And thou hast foreseen all my ways: * for there is no speech on my tongue.

segments.t: Et omnes vias meas prævidísti: * quia non est sermo in lingua mea.

content.latin: 138:5 Ecce, Dómine, tu cognovísti ómnia novíssima, et antíqua: * tu formásti me, et posuísti super me manum tuam.
content.english: 138:5 Behold, O Lord, thou hast known all things, the last and those of old: * thou hast formed me, and hast laid thy hand upon me.

segments.t: Ecce, Dómine, tu cognovísti ómnia novíssima, et antíqua: * tu formásti me, et posuísti super me manum tuam.

content.latin: 138:6 Mirábilis facta est sciéntia tua ex me: * confortáta est, et non pótero ad eam.
content.english: 138:6 Thy knowledge is become wonderful to me: * it is high, and I cannot reach to it.

segments.t: Mirábilis facta est sciéntia tua ex me: * confortáta est, et non pótero ad eam.

content.latin: 138:7 Quo ibo a spíritu tuo? * et quo a fácie tua fúgiam?
content.english: 138:7 Whither shall I go from thy spirit? * or whither shall I flee from thy face?

segments.t: Quo ibo a spíritu tuo? * et quo a fácie tua fúgiam?

content.latin: 138:8 Si ascéndero in cælum, tu illic es: * si descéndero in inférnum, ades.
content.english: 138:8 If I ascend into heaven, thou art there: * if I descend into hell, thou art present.

segments.t: Si ascéndero in cælum, tu illic es: * si descéndero in inférnum, ades.

content.latin: 138:9 Si súmpsero pennas meas dilúculo, * et habitávero in extrémis maris:
content.english: 138:9 If I take my wings early in the morning, * and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea:

segments.t: Si súmpsero pennas meas dilúculo, * et habitávero in extrémis maris:

content.latin: 138:10 Étenim illuc manus tua dedúcet me: * et tenébit me déxtera tua.
content.english: 138:10 Even there also shall thy hand lead me: * and thy right hand shall hold me.

segments.t: Étenim illuc manus tua dedúcet me: * et tenébit me déxtera tua.

content.latin: 138:11 Et dixi: Fórsitan ténebræ conculcábunt me: * et nox illuminátio mea in delíciis meis.
content.english: 138:11 And I said: Perhaps darkness shall cover me: * and night shall be my light in my pleasures.

segments.t: Et dixi: Fórsitan ténebræ conculcábunt me: * et nox illuminátio mea in delíciis meis.

content.latin: 138:12 Quia ténebræ non obscurabúntur a te, et nox sicut dies illuminábitur: * sicut ténebræ eius, ita et lumen eius.
content.english: 138:12 But darkness shall not be dark to thee, and night shall be light as the day: * the darkness thereof, and the light thereof are alike to thee.

segments.t: Quia ténebræ non obscurabúntur a te, et nox sicut dies illuminábitur: * sicut ténebræ eius, ita et lumen eius.

content.latin: 138:13 Quia tu possedísti renes meos: * suscepísti me de útero matris meæ.
content.english: 138:13 For thou hast possessed my reins: * thou hast protected me from my mother’s womb.

segments.t: Quia tu possedísti renes meos: * suscepísti me de útero matris meæ.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Dómine, probásti me et cognovísti me.
content.english: Ant. Lord, thou hast proved me, and known me.

segments.t: Ant.
Dómine, probásti me et cognovísti me.

content.latin: Ant. Mirabília ópera tua, * Dómine, et ánima mea cognóscit nimis.
content.english: Ant. Wonderful are thy works * and my soul knoweth right well.

segments.t: Ant.
Mirabília ópera tua, * Dómine, et ánima mea cognóscit nimis.
Psalmus 138(14-24)

content.latin: 138:14 Confitébor tibi quia terribíliter magnificátus es: * mirabília ópera tua, et ánima mea cognóscit nimis.
content.english: 138:14 I will praise thee, for thou art fearfully magnified: * wonderful are thy works, and my soul knoweth right well.

segments.t: Confitébor tibi quia terribíliter magnificátus es: * mirabília ópera tua, et ánima mea cognóscit nimis.

content.latin: 138:15 Non est occultátum os meum a te, quod fecísti in occúlto: * et substántia mea in inferióribus terræ.
content.english: 138:15 My bone is not hidden from thee, which thou hast made in secret: * and my substance in the lower parts of the earth.

segments.t: Non est occultátum os meum a te, quod fecísti in occúlto: * et substántia mea in inferióribus terræ.

content.latin: 138:16 Imperféctum meum vidérunt óculi tui, et in libro tuo omnes scribéntur: * dies formabúntur, et nemo in eis.
content.english: 138:16 Thy eyes did see my imperfect being, and in thy book all shall be written: * days shall be formed, and no one in them.

segments.t: Imperféctum meum vidérunt óculi tui, et in libro tuo omnes scribéntur: * dies formabúntur, et nemo in eis.

content.latin: 138:17 Mihi autem nimis honorificáti sunt amíci tui, Deus: * nimis confortátus est principátus eórum.
content.english: 138:17 But to me thy friends, O God, are made exceedingly honourable: * their principality is exceedingly strengthened.

segments.t: Mihi autem nimis honorificáti sunt amíci tui, Deus: * nimis confortátus est principátus eórum.

content.latin: 138:18 Dinumerábo eos, et super arénam multiplicabúntur: * exsurréxi, et adhuc sum tecum.
content.english: 138:18 I will number them, and they shall be multiplied above the sand: * I rose up and am still with thee.

segments.t: Dinumerábo eos, et super arénam multiplicabúntur: * exsurréxi, et adhuc sum tecum.

content.latin: 138:19 Si occíderis, Deus, peccatóres: * viri sánguinum, declináte a me:
content.english: 138:19 If thou wilt kill the wicked, O God: * ye men of blood, depart from me:

segments.t: Si occíderis, Deus, peccatóres: * viri sánguinum, declináte a me:

content.latin: 138:20 Quia dícitis in cogitatióne: * Accípient in vanitáte civitátes tuas.
content.english: 138:20 Because you say in thought: * They shall receive thy cities in vain.

segments.t: Quia dícitis in cogitatióne: * Accípient in vanitáte civitátes tuas.

content.latin: 138:21 Nonne qui odérunt te, Dómine, óderam? * et super inimícos tuos tabescébam?
content.english: 138:21 Have I not hated them, O Lord, that hated thee: * and pined away because of thy enemies?

segments.t: Nonne qui odérunt te, Dómine, óderam? * et super inimícos tuos tabescébam?

content.latin: 138:22 Perfécto ódio óderam illos: * et inimíci facti sunt mihi.
content.english: 138:22 I have hated them with a perfect hatred: * and they are become enemies to me.

segments.t: Perfécto ódio óderam illos: * et inimíci facti sunt mihi.

content.latin: 138:23 Proba me, Deus, et scito cor meum: * intérroga me, et cognósce sémitas meas.
content.english: 138:23 Prove me, O God, and know my heart: * examine me, and know my paths.

segments.t: Proba me, Deus, et scito cor meum: * intérroga me, et cognósce sémitas meas.

content.latin: 138:24 Et vide, si via iniquitátis in me est: * et deduc me in via ætérna.
content.english: 138:24 And see if there be in me the way of iniquity: * and lead me in the eternal way.

segments.t: Et vide, si via iniquitátis in me est: * et deduc me in via ætérna.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.latin: Ant. Mirabília ópera tua, Dómine, et ánima mea cognóscit nimis.
content.english: Ant. Wonderful are thy works and my soul knoweth right well.

segments.t: Ant.
Mirabília ópera tua, Dómine, et ánima mea cognóscit nimis.

content.latin: Ant. Ne derelínquas me, * Dómine, virtus salútis meæ.
content.english: Ant. Do not thou forsake me, * O Lord, the strength of my salvation.

segments.t: Ant.
Ne derelínquas me, * Dómine, virtus salútis meæ.

content.latin: Psalmus 139 [3]
content.english: Psalm 139 [3]

segments.t: Psalmus 139

content.latin: 139:2 Éripe me, Dómine, ab hómine malo: * a viro iníquo éripe me.
content.english: 139:2 Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man: * rescue me from the unjust man.

segments.t: Éripe me, Dómine, ab hómine malo: * a viro iníquo éripe me.

content.latin: 139:3 Qui cogitavérunt iniquitátes in corde: * tota die constituébant prǽlia.
content.english: 139:3 Who have devised iniquities in their hearts: * all the day long they designed battles.

segments.t: Qui cogitavérunt iniquitátes in corde: * tota die constituébant prǽlia.

content.latin: 139:4 Acuérunt linguas suas sicut serpéntis: * venénum áspidum sub lábiis eórum.
content.english: 139:4 They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent: * the venom of asps is under their lips.

segments.t: Acuérunt linguas suas sicut serpéntis: * venénum áspidum sub lábiis eórum.

content.latin: 139:5 Custódi me, Dómine, de manu peccatóris: * et ab homínibus iníquis éripe me.
content.english: 139:5 Keep me, O Lord, from the hand of the wicked: * and from unjust men deliver me.

segments.t: Custódi me, Dómine, de manu peccatóris: * et ab homínibus iníquis éripe me.

content.latin: 139:5 Qui cogitavérunt supplantáre gressus meos: * abscondérunt supérbi láqueum mihi:
content.english: 139:5 Who have proposed to supplant my steps: * the proud have hidden a net for me.

segments.t: Qui cogitavérunt supplantáre gressus meos: * abscondérunt supérbi láqueum mihi:

content.latin: 139:6 Et funes extendérunt in láqueum: * iuxta iter scándalum posuérunt mihi.
content.english: 139:6 And they have stretched out cords for a snare: * they have laid for me a stumbling block by the wayside.

segments.t: Et funes extendérunt in láqueum: * iuxta iter scándalum posuérunt mihi.

content.latin: 139:7 Dixi Dómino: Deus meus es tu: * exáudi, Dómine, vocem deprecatiónis meæ.
content.english: 139:7 I said to the Lord: Thou art my God: * hear, O Lord, the voice of my supplication.

segments.t: Dixi Dómino: Deus meus es tu: * exáudi, Dómine, vocem deprecatiónis meæ.

content.latin: 139:8 Dómine, Dómine, virtus salútis meæ: * obumbrásti super caput meum in die belli.
content.english: 139:8 O Lord, Lord, the strength of my salvation: * thou hast overshadowed my head in the day of battle.

segments.t: Dómine, Dómine, virtus salútis meæ: * obumbrásti super caput meum in die belli.

content.latin: 139:9 Ne tradas me, Dómine, a desidério meo peccatóri: * cogitavérunt contra me, ne derelínquas me, ne forte exalténtur.
content.english: 139:9 Give me not up, O Lord, from my desire to the wicked: * they have plotted against me; do not thou forsake me, lest they should triumph.

segments.t: Ne tradas me, Dómine, a desidério meo peccatóri: * cogitavérunt contra me, ne derelínquas me, ne forte exalténtur.

content.latin: 139:10 Caput circúitus eórum: * labor labiórum ipsórum opériet eos.
content.english: 139:10 The head of them compassing me about: * the labour of their lips shall overwhelm them.

segments.t: Caput circúitus eórum: * labor labiórum ipsórum opériet eos.

content.latin: 139:11 Cadent super eos carbónes, in ignem deícies eos: * in misériis non subsístent.
content.english: 139:11 Burning coals shall fall upon them; thou wilt cast them down into the fire: * in miseries they shall not be able to stand.

segments.t: Cadent super eos carbónes, in ignem deícies eos: * in misériis non subsístent.

content.latin: 139:12 Vir linguósus non dirigétur in terra: * virum iniústum mala cápient in intéritu.
content.english: 139:12 A man full of tongue shall not be established in the earth: * evil shall catch the unjust man unto destruction.

segments.t: Vir linguósus non dirigétur in terra: * virum iniústum mala cápient in intéritu.

content.latin: 139:13 Cognóvi quia fáciet Dóminus iudícium ínopis: * et vindíctam páuperum.
content.english: 139:13 I know that the Lord will do justice to the needy, * and will revenge the poor.

segments.t: Cognóvi quia fáciet Dóminus iudícium ínopis: * et vindíctam páuperum.

content.latin: 139:14 Verúmtamen iusti confitebúntur nómini tuo: * et habitábunt recti cum vultu tuo.
content.english: 139:14 But as for the just, they shall give glory to thy name: * and the upright shall dwell with thy countenance.

segments.t: Verúmtamen iusti confitebúntur nómini tuo: * et habitábunt recti cum vultu tuo.

content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

content.english: Psalm 140 [4]

segments.t: Psalmus 140

content.latin: 140:1 Dómine, clamávi ad te, exáudi me: * ‡ inténde voci meæ, cum clamávero ad te.
content.english: 140:1 I have cried to thee, O Lord, hear me: * ‡ hearken to my voice, when I cry to thee.

segments.t: Dómine, clamávi ad te, exáudi me: *
inténde voci meæ, cum clamávero ad te.

content.latin: 140:2 Dirigátur orátio mea sicut incénsum in conspéctu tuo: * elevátio mánuum meárum sacrifícium vespertínum.
content.english: 140:2 Let my prayer be directed as incense in thy sight; * the lifting up of my hands, as evening sacrifice.

segments.t: Dirigátur orátio mea sicut incénsum in conspéctu tuo: * elevátio mánuum meárum sacrifícium vespertínum.

content.latin: 140:3 Pone, Dómine, custódiam ori meo: * et óstium circumstántiæ lábiis meis.
content.english: 140:3 Set a watch, O Lord, before my mouth: * and a door round about my lips.

segments.t: Pone, Dómine, custódiam ori meo: * et óstium circumstántiæ lábiis meis.

content.latin: 140:4 Non declínes cor meum in verba malítiæ, * ad excusándas excusatiónes in peccátis.
content.english: 140:4 Incline not my heart to evil words; * to make excuses in sins.

segments.t: Non declínes cor meum in verba malítiæ, * ad excusándas excusatiónes in peccátis.

content.latin: 140:4 Cum homínibus operántibus iniquitátem: * et non communicábo cum eléctis eórum.
content.english: 140:4 With men that work iniquity: * and I will not communicate with the choicest of them.

segments.t: Cum homínibus operántibus iniquitátem: * et non communicábo cum eléctis eórum.

content.latin: 140:5 Corrípiet me iustus in misericórdia, et increpábit me: * óleum autem peccatóris non impínguet caput meum.
content.english: 140:5 The just man shall correct me in mercy, and shall reprove me: * but let not the oil of the sinner fatten my head.

segments.t: Corrípiet me iustus in misericórdia, et increpábit me: * óleum autem peccatóris non impínguet caput meum.

content.latin: 140:6 Quóniam adhuc et orátio mea in beneplácitis eórum: * absórpti sunt iuncti petræ iúdices eórum.
content.english: 140:6 For my prayer also shall still be against the things with which they are well pleased: * their judges falling upon the rock have been swallowed up.

segments.t: Quóniam adhuc et orátio mea in beneplácitis eórum: * absórpti sunt iuncti petræ iúdices eórum.

content.latin: 140:7 Áudient verba mea quóniam potuérunt: * sicut crassitúdo terræ erúpta est super terram.
content.english: 140:7 They shall hear my words, for they have prevailed: * as when the thickness of the earth is broken up upon the ground.

segments.t: Áudient verba mea quóniam potuérunt: * sicut crassitúdo terræ erúpta est super terram.

content.latin: 140:8 Dissipáta sunt ossa nostra secus inférnum: * quia ad te, Dómine, Dómine, óculi mei: in te sperávi, non áuferas ánimam meam.
content.english: 140:8 Our bones are scattered by the side of hell. * But to thee, O Lord, Lord, are my eyes: in thee have I put my trust, take not away my soul.

segments.t: Dissipáta sunt ossa nostra secus inférnum: * quia ad te, Dómine, Dómine, óculi mei: in te sperávi, non áuferas ánimam meam.

content.latin: 140:9 Custódi me a láqueo, quem statuérunt mihi: * et a scándalis operántium iniquitátem.
content.english: 140:9 Keep me from the snare, which they have laid for me, * and from the stumbling blocks of them that work iniquity.

segments.t: Custódi me a láqueo, quem statuérunt mihi: * et a scándalis operántium iniquitátem.

content.latin: 140:10 Cadent in retiáculo eius peccatóres: * singuláriter sum ego donec tránseam.
content.english: 140:10 The wicked shall fall in his net: * I am alone until I pass.

segments.t: Cadent in retiáculo eius peccatóres: * singuláriter sum ego donec tránseam.

content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.

content.english: Psalm 141 [5]

segments.t: Psalmus 141

content.latin: 141:2 Voce mea ad Dóminum clamávi: * voce mea ad Dóminum deprecátus sum:
content.english: 141:2 I cried to the Lord with my voice: * with my voice I made supplication to the Lord.

segments.t: Voce mea ad Dóminum clamávi: * voce mea ad Dóminum deprecátus sum:

content.latin: 141:3 Effúndo in conspéctu eius oratiónem meam, * et tribulatiónem meam ante ipsum pronúntio.
content.english: 141:3 In his sight I pour out my prayer, * and before him I declare my trouble:

segments.t: Effúndo in conspéctu eius oratiónem meam, * et tribulatiónem meam ante ipsum pronúntio.

content.latin: 141:4 In deficiéndo ex me spíritum meum, * et tu cognovísti sémitas meas.
content.english: 141:4 When my spirit failed me, * then thou knewest my paths.

segments.t: In deficiéndo ex me spíritum meum, * et tu cognovísti sémitas meas.

content.latin: 141:4 In via hac, qua ambulábam, * abscondérunt láqueum mihi.
content.english: 141:4 In this way wherein I walked, * they have hidden a snare for me.

segments.t: In via hac, qua ambulábam, * abscondérunt láqueum mihi.

content.latin: 141:5 Considerábam ad déxteram, et vidébam: * et non erat qui cognósceret me.
content.english: 141:5 I looked on my right hand, and beheld, * and there was no one that would know me.

segments.t: Considerábam ad déxteram, et vidébam: * et non erat qui cognósceret me.

content.latin: 141:5 Périit fuga a me, * et non est qui requírat ánimam meam.
content.english: 141:5 Flight hath failed me: * and there is no one that hath regard to my soul.

segments.t: Périit fuga a me, * et non est qui requírat ánimam meam.

content.latin: 141:6 Clamávi ad te, Dómine, * dixi: Tu es spes mea, pórtio mea in terra vivéntium.
content.english: 141:6 I cried to thee, O Lord: * I said: Thou art my hope, my portion in the land of the living.

segments.t: Clamávi ad te, Dómine, * dixi: Tu es spes mea, pórtio mea in terra vivéntium.

content.latin: 141:7 Inténde ad deprecatiónem meam: * quia humiliátus sum nimis.
content.english: 141:7 Attend to my supplication: * for I am brought very low.

segments.t: Inténde ad deprecatiónem meam: * quia humiliátus sum nimis.

content.latin: 141:7 Líbera me a persequéntibus me: * quia confortáti sunt super me.
content.english: 141:7 Deliver me from my persecutors; * for they are stronger than I.

segments.t: Líbera me a persequéntibus me: * quia confortáti sunt super me.

content.latin: 141:8 Educ de custódia ánimam meam ad confiténdum nómini tuo: * me exspéctant iusti, donec retríbuas mihi.
content.english: 141:8 Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: * the just wait for me, until thou reward me.

segments.t: Educ de custódia ánimam meam ad confiténdum nómini tuo: * me exspéctant iusti, donec retríbuas mihi.

Educ de custódia ánimam meam, Dómine, ad confiténdum nómini tuo.

content.latin: Benedíctus Deus, et Pater Dómini nostri Iesu Christi, Pater misericordiárum, et Deus totíus consolatiónis, qui consolátur nos in omni tribulatióne nostra.
content.english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort, who comforteth us in all our tribulation.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.english: Hymn

segments.t: Hymnus

content.latin: Hóminis superne Cónditor,
content.english: Maker of man, who from thy throne

content.latin: Qui cuncta solus órdinans,
content.english: Dost order all things, God alone;

content.latin: Humum iubes prodúcere
content.english: By whose decree the teeming earth

content.latin: Reptántis et feræ genus:
content.english: To reptile and to beast gave birth:

content.latin: Et magna rerum córpora,
content.english: The mighty forms that fill the land,

content.latin: Dictu iubéntis vívida,
content.english: Instinct with life at thy command,

content.latin: Per témporum certas vices
content.english: Are given subdued to humankind

content.latin: Obtemperáre sérvulis:
content.english: For service in their rank assigned.

content.latin: Repélle, quod cupídinis
content.english: From all thy servants drive away

content.latin: Ciénte vi nos ímpetit,
content.english: Whate’er of thought impure to-day

content.latin: Aut móribus se súggerit,
content.english: Hath been with open action blent,

content.latin: Aut áctibus se intérserit.
content.english: Or mingled with the heart’s intent.

content.latin: Da gaudiórum prǽmia,
content.english: In heaven thine endless joys bestow,

content.latin: Da gratiárum múnera:
content.english: And grant thy gifts of grace below;

content.latin: Dissólve litis víncula:
content.english: From chains of strife our souls release,

content.latin: Astrínge pacis fœ́dera.
content.english: Bind fast the gentle bands of peace.

content.latin: Præsta, Pater piíssime,
content.english: Grant this, O Father, ever One

content.latin: Patríque compar Únice,
content.english: With Christ, thy sole-begotten Son,

content.latin: Cum Spíritu Paráclito
content.english: Whom, with the Spirit we adore,

content.latin: Regnans per omne sǽculum.
content.english: One God, both now and evermore.

content.latin: Amen.
content.english: Amen.

content.english: ℣. O Lord, direct my prayer.

segments.t: Dirigátur, Dómine, orátio mea.

content.english: ℟. As incense in thy sight.

segments.t: Sicut incénsum in conspéctu tuo.

content.english: Canticle of the Blessed Virgin

content.latin: 1:46 Magníficat ✠ * ánima mea Dóminum.
content.english: 1:46 My soul ✠ * doth magnify the Lord.

segments.t: Magníficat ✠ * ánima mea Dóminum.

content.latin: 1:47 Et exsultávit spíritus meus: * in Deo, salutári meo.
content.english: 1:47 And my spirit hath rejoiced * in God my Saviour.

segments.t: Et exsultávit spíritus meus: * in Deo, salutári meo.

content.latin: 1:48 Quia respéxit humilitátem ancíllæ suæ: * ecce enim ex hoc beátam me dicent omnes generatiónes.
content.english: 1:48 Because he hath regarded the humility of his handmaid; * for behold from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.

segments.t: Quia respéxit humilitátem ancíllæ suæ: * ecce enim ex hoc beátam me dicent omnes generatiónes.

content.latin: 1:49 Quia fecit mihi magna qui potens est: * et sanctum nomen eius.
content.english: 1:49 Because he that is mighty, hath done great things to me; * and holy is his name.

segments.t: Quia fecit mihi magna qui potens est: * et sanctum nomen eius.

content.latin: 1:50 Et misericórdia eius, a progénie in progénies: * timéntibus eum.
content.english: 1:50 And his mercy is from generation unto generations, * to them that fear him.

segments.t: Et misericórdia eius, a progénie in progénies: * timéntibus eum.

content.latin: 1:51 Fecit poténtiam in brácchio suo: * dispérsit supérbos mente cordis sui.
content.english: 1:51 He hath shewed might in his arm: * he hath scattered the proud in the conceit of their heart.

segments.t: Fecit poténtiam in brácchio suo: * dispérsit supérbos mente cordis sui.

content.latin: 1:52 Depósuit poténtes de sede: * et exaltávit húmiles.
content.english: 1:52 He hath put down the mighty from their seat, * and hath exalted the humble.

segments.t: Depósuit poténtes de sede: * et exaltávit húmiles.

content.latin: 1:53 Esuriéntes implévit bonis: * et dívites dimísit inánes.
content.english: 1:53 He hath filled the hungry with good things; * and the rich he hath sent empty away.

segments.t: Esuriéntes implévit bonis: * et dívites dimísit inánes.

content.latin: 1:54 Suscépit Israël púerum suum: * recordátus misericórdiæ suæ.
content.english: 1:54 He hath received Israel his servant, * being mindful of his mercy:

segments.t: Suscépit Israël púerum suum: * recordátus misericórdiæ suæ.

content.latin: 1:55 Sicut locútus est ad patres nostros: * Ábraham, et sémini eius in sǽcula.
content.english: 1:55 As he spoke to our fathers, * to Abraham and to his seed for ever.

segments.t: Sicut locútus est ad patres nostros: * Ábraham, et sémini eius in sǽcula.

content.latin: Kýrie, eléison. Christe, eléison. Kýrie, eléison.
content.english: Lord have mercy upon us, Christ have mercy upon us, Lord have mercy upon us.

content.latin: Pater noster, qui es in cælis, sanctificétur nomen tuum: advéniat regnum tuum: fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo et in terra. Panem nostrum cotidiánum da nobis hódie: et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris:
content.english: Our Father, who art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread. And forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us.

content.latin: ℣. Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:
content.english: ℣. And lead us not into temptation:

segments.t: Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:

content.latin: ℟. Sed líbera nos a malo.
content.english: ℟. But deliver us from evil.

segments.t: Sed líbera nos a malo.

content.latin: ℣. Ego dixi: Dómine, miserére mei.
content.english: ℣. I said: Lord, be merciful unto me:

segments.t: Ego dixi: Dómine, miserére mei.

content.latin: ℟. Sana ánimam meam quia peccávi tibi.
content.english: ℟. Heal my soul, for I have sinned against thee.

segments.t: Sana ánimam meam quia peccávi tibi.

content.latin: ℣. Convértere, Dómine, úsquequo?
content.english: ℣. Turn thee again, O Lord; how long will it be?

segments.t: Convértere, Dómine, úsquequo?

content.latin: ℟. Et deprecábilis esto super servos tuos.
content.english: ℟. And be gracious unto thy servants.

segments.t: Et deprecábilis esto super servos tuos.

content.latin: ℣. Fiat misericórdia tua, Dómine, super nos.
content.english: ℣. Let thy mercy, O Lord, be upon us.

segments.t: Fiat misericórdia tua, Dómine, super nos.

content.latin: ℟. Quemádmodum sperávimus in te.
content.english: ℟. As we have hoped in thee.

segments.t: Quemádmodum sperávimus in te.

content.latin: ℣. Sacerdótes tui induántur iustítiam.
content.english: ℣. Let thy priests be clothed with justice:

segments.t: Sacerdótes tui induántur iustítiam.

content.latin: ℟. Et sancti tui exsúltent.
content.english: ℟. And may thy saints rejoice.

segments.t: Et sancti tui exsúltent.

content.latin: ℣. Orémus pro beatíssimo Papa nostro N.
content.english: ℣. Let us pray for our most blessed Pope N.

segments.t: Orémus pro beatíssimo Papa nostro
N.

content.latin: ℟. Dóminus consérvet eum, et vivíficet eum, et beátum fáciat eum in terra, et non tradat eum in ánimam inimicórum eius.
content.english: ℟. The Lord preserve him and give him life, and make him blessed upon the earth: and deliver him not up to the will of his enemies.

segments.t: Dóminus consérvet eum, et vivíficet eum, et beátum fáciat eum in terra, et non tradat eum in ánimam inimicórum eius.

content.latin: ℣. Orémus et pro Antístite nostro N.
content.english: ℣. Let us pray for our bishop N.

segments.t: Orémus et pro Antístite nostro
N.

content.latin: ℟. Stet et pascat in fortitúdine tua, Dómine, in sublimitáte nóminis tui.
content.english: ℟. May he stand firm and care for us in the strength of the Lord, in the might of thy name.

segments.t: Stet et pascat in fortitúdine tua, Dómine, in sublimitáte nóminis tui.

content.latin: Romæ præcedens Versus cum suo Responsorio omittitur; alibi vero ad litteram N. ab omnibus nomen diœcesani Episcopi exprimatur, Vacante Apostolica vel Episcopali Sede, alteruter vel uterque respectivus Versus cum suo Responsorio præteritur.
content.english: In Rome, the preceding Versicle and its Response are omitted. Elsewhere, the name of the local Ordinary is inserted at the letter N. If the Holy See or the See of the local Bishop is vacant, the appropriate V. and R., either or both as the case may be, is omitted.

segments.t: Romæ præcedens Versus cum suo Responsorio omittitur; alibi vero ad litteram N. ab omnibus nomen diœcesani Episcopi exprimatur, Vacante Apostolica vel Episcopali Sede, alteruter vel uterque respectivus Versus cum suo Responsorio præteritur.

content.latin: ℣. Dómine, salvum fac regem.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, save our leaders.

segments.t: Dómine, salvum fac regem.

content.latin: ℟. Et exáudi nos in die, qua invocavérimus te.
content.english: ℟. And mercifully hear us when we call upon thee.

segments.t: Et exáudi nos in die, qua invocavérimus te.

content.latin: ℣. Salvum fac pópulum tuum, Dómine, et bénedic hereditáti tuæ.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, save thy people, and bless thine inheritance:

segments.t: Salvum fac pópulum tuum, Dómine, et bénedic hereditáti tuæ.

content.latin: ℟. Et rege eos, et extólle illos usque in ætérnum.
content.english: ℟. Govern them and lift them up for ever.

segments.t: Et rege eos, et extólle illos usque in ætérnum.

content.latin: ℣. Meménto Congregatiónis tuæ.
content.english: ℣. Remember thy congregation,

segments.t: Meménto Congregatiónis tuæ.

content.latin: ℟. Quam possedísti ab inítio.
content.english: ℟. Which thou hast possessed from the beginning.

segments.t: Quam possedísti ab inítio.

content.latin: ℣. Fiat pax in virtúte tua.
content.english: ℣. Let peace be in thy strength:

segments.t: Fiat pax in virtúte tua.

content.latin: ℟. Et abundántia in túrribus tuis.
content.english: ℟. And abundance in thy towers.

segments.t: Et abundántia in túrribus tuis.

content.latin: ℣. Orémus pro benefactóribus nostris.
content.english: ℣. Let us pray for our benefactors.

segments.t: Orémus pro benefactóribus nostris.

content.latin: ℟. Retribúere dignáre, Dómine, ómnibus, nobis bona faciéntibus propter nomen tuum, vitam ætérnam. Amen.
content.english: ℟. O Lord, for thy name's sake, deign to reward with eternal life all who do us good. Amen.

segments.t: Retribúere dignáre, Dómine, ómnibus, nobis bona faciéntibus propter nomen tuum, vitam ætérnam. Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Orémus pro fidélibus defúnctis.
content.english: ℣. Let us pray for the faithful departed.

segments.t: Orémus pro fidélibus defúnctis.

content.latin: ℟. Réquiem ætérnam dona eis, Dómine, et lux perpétua lúceat eis.
content.english: ℟. Eternal rest grant unto them, O Lord, and let perpetual light shine upon them.

segments.t: Réquiem ætérnam dona eis, Dómine, et lux perpétua lúceat eis.

content.latin: ℣. Requiéscant in pace.
content.english: ℣. May they rest in peace.

segments.t: Requiéscant in pace.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Pro frátribus nostris abséntibus.
content.english: ℣. Let us pray for our absent brothers.

segments.t: Pro frátribus nostris abséntibus.

content.latin: ℟. Salvos fac servos tuos, Deus meus, sperántes in te.
content.english: ℟. Save thy servants, O God, who put their trust in thee.

segments.t: Salvos fac servos tuos, Deus meus, sperántes in te.

content.latin: ℣. Pro afflíctis et captívis.
content.english: ℣. Let us pray for the afflicted and imprisoned.

segments.t: Pro afflíctis et captívis.

content.latin: ℟. Líbera eos, Deus Israël, ex ómnibus tribulatiónibus suis.
content.english: ℟. Deliver them, God of Israel, from all their tribulations.

segments.t: Líbera eos, Deus Israël, ex ómnibus tribulatiónibus suis.

content.latin: ℣. Mitte eis, Dómine, auxílium de sancto.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, send them help from thy sanctuary.

segments.t: Mitte eis, Dómine, auxílium de sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Et de Sion tuére eos.
content.english: ℟. And defend them out of Sion.

segments.t: Et de Sion tuére eos.

content.latin: ℣. Dómine, Deus virtútum, convérte nos.
content.english: ℣. Turn us again, O Lord, God of Hosts.

segments.t: Dómine, Deus virtútum, convérte nos.

content.latin: ℟. Et osténde fáciem tuam, et salvi érimus.
content.english: ℟. Show us thy face, and we shall be whole.

segments.t: Et osténde fáciem tuam, et salvi érimus.

content.latin: ℣. Exsúrge, Christe, ádiuva nos.
content.english: ℣. Arise, O Christ, and help us.

segments.t: Exsúrge, Christe, ádiuva nos.

content.latin: ℟. Et líbera nos propter nomen tuum.
content.english: ℟. And redeem us for thy name's sake.

segments.t: Et líbera nos propter nomen tuum.

content.latin: ℣. Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: secunda Domine, exaudi omittitur
content.english: skip second O Lord, hear my prayer

segments.t: secunda Domine, exaudi omittitur

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Præsta, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut observatiónes sacras ánnua devotióne recoléntes, et córpore tibi placeámus, et mente.
content.english: Grant, we beseech thee, O Almighty God, that we who every year do earnestly renew the sacred observance of this Fast, may please thee both in body and in soul.

content.latin: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Through Jesus Christ, thy Son our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.
content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

segments.t: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam.

content.latin: ℟. Et clamor meus ad te véniat.
content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: ℣. Benedicámus Dómino.
content.english: ℣. Let us bless the Lord.

segments.t: Benedicámus Dómino.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℣. Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.
content.english: ℣. May the souls of the faithful, through the mercy of God, rest in peace.

segments.t: Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Iube, Dómine, benedícere.
content.english: ℣. Grant, Lord, a blessing.

segments.t: Iube, Dómine, benedícere.

content.latin: Benedictio. Noctem quiétam et finem perféctum concédat nobis Dóminus omnípotens.
content.english: Benediction. May almighty God grant us a quiet night and a perfect end.

segments.t: Benedictio.
Noctem quiétam et finem perféctum concédat nobis Dóminus omnípotens.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: Fratres: Sóbrii estóte, et vigiláte: quia adversárius vester diábolus tamquam leo rúgiens círcuit, quærens quem dévoret: cui resístite fortes in fide.
content.english: Brothers: Be sober and watch: because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, goeth about seeking whom he may devour. Whom resist ye, strong in faith.

content.latin: ℣. Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.
content.english: ℣. But thou, O Lord, have mercy upon us.

segments.t: Tu autem, Dómine, miserére nobis.

content.latin: ℟. Deo grátias.
content.english: ℟. Thanks be to God.

segments.t: Deo grátias.

content.latin: ℣. Adiutórium nostrum ✠ in nómine Dómini.
content.english: ℣. Our help is ✠ in the name of the Lord,

segments.t: Adiutórium nostrum ✠ in nómine Dómini.

content.latin: ℟. Qui fecit cælum et terram.
content.english: ℟. Who made heaven and earth.

segments.t: Qui fecit cælum et terram.

content.latin: Examen conscientiæ vel Pater Noster totum secreto.
content.english: There follows an examination of conscience, or the Our Father said silently.

segments.t: Examen conscientiæ vel Pater Noster totum secreto.

content.latin: Pater noster, qui es in cælis, sanctificétur nomen tuum: advéniat regnum tuum: fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo et in terra. Panem nostrum cotidiánum da nobis hódie: et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris: et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem: sed líbera nos a malo. Amen.
content.english: Our Father, who art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread. And forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation: But deliver us from evil. Amen.

content.latin: Confíteor Deo omnipoténti, beátæ Maríæ semper Vírgini, beáto Michaéli Archángelo, beáto Ioánni Baptístæ, sanctis Apóstolis Petro et Paulo, et ómnibus Sanctis, quia peccávi nimis, cogitatióne, verbo et ópere: percutit sibi pectus mea culpa, mea culpa, mea máxima culpa. Ídeo precor beátam Maríam semper Vírginem, beátum Michaélem Archángelum, beátum Ioánnem Baptístam, sanctos Apóstolos Petrum et Paulum, et omnes Sanctos, oráre pro me ad Dóminum Deum nostrum.
content.english: I confess to almighty God, to blessed Mary ever Virgin, to blessed Michael the Archangel, to blessed John the Baptist, to the holy Apostles Peter and Paul, and to all the Saints, that I have sinned exceedingly in thought, word and deed: strikes his breast through my fault, through my fault, through my most grievous fault. Therefore I beseech blessed Mary ever Virgin, blessed Michael the Archangel, blessed John the Baptist, the holy Apostles Peter and Paul, and all the Saints, to pray for me to the Lord our God.

segments.t: Confíteor Deo omnipoténti, beátæ Maríæ semper Vírgini, beáto Michaéli Archángelo, beáto Ioánni Baptístæ, sanctis Apóstolis Petro et Paulo, et ómnibus Sanctis, quia peccávi nimis, cogitatióne, verbo et ópere:
percutit sibi pectus

mea culpa, mea culpa, mea máxima culpa. Ídeo precor beátam Maríam semper Vírginem, beátum Michaélem Archángelum, beátum Ioánnem Baptístam, sanctos Apóstolos Petrum et Paulum, et omnes Sanctos, oráre pro me ad Dóminum Deum nostrum.

content.latin: Misereátur nostri omnípotens Deus, et dimíssis peccátis nostris, perdúcat nos ad vitam ætérnam. Amen.
content.english: May almighty God have mercy on us, forgive us our sins, and bring us to everlasting life. Amen.

content.latin: Indulgéntiam, ✠ absolutiónem et remissiónem peccatórum nostrórum tríbuat nobis omnípotens et miséricors Dóminus. Amen.
content.english: May the almighty ✠ and merciful Lord grant us pardon, absolution and remission of our sins. Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Convérte nos ✙︎ Deus, salutáris noster.
content.english: ℣. Turn us then, ✙︎ O God, our saviour:

segments.t: Convérte nos ✙︎ Deus, salutáris noster.

content.latin: ℟. Et avérte iram tuam a nobis.
content.english: ℟. And let thy anger cease from us.

segments.t: Et avérte iram tuam a nobis.

content.latin: ℣. Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.
content.english: ℣. O God, ✠ come to my assistance;

segments.t: Deus ✠ in adiutórium meum inténde.

content.latin: ℟. Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.
content.english: ℟. O Lord, make haste to help me.

segments.t: Dómine, ad adiuvándum me festína.

content.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

content.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

content.latin: Allelúia.
content.english: Alleluia.

content.latin: Ant. Voce mea * ad Dóminum clamávi: neque obliviscétur miseréri Deus.
content.english: Ant. I have cried * to the Lord with my voice, do not forget to show mercy, O God.

segments.t: Ant.
Voce mea * ad Dóminum clamávi: neque obliviscétur miseréri Deus.
Psalmus 76(2-13)

content.latin: 76:2 Voce mea ad Dóminum clamávi: * voce mea ad Deum, et inténdit mihi.
content.english: 76:2 I cried to the Lord with my voice; * to God with my voice, and he gave ear to me.

segments.t: Voce mea ad Dóminum clamávi: * voce mea ad Deum, et inténdit mihi.

content.latin: 76:3 In die tribulatiónis meæ Deum exquisívi, mánibus meis nocte contra eum: * et non sum decéptus.
content.english: 76:3 In the day of my trouble I sought God, with my hands lifted up to him in the night, * and I was not deceived.

segments.t: In die tribulatiónis meæ Deum exquisívi, mánibus meis nocte contra eum: * et non sum decéptus.

content.latin: 76:4 Rénuit consolári ánima mea, * memor fui Dei, et delectátus sum, et exercitátus sum: et defécit spíritus meus.
content.english: 76:4 My soul refused to be comforted: * I remembered God, and was delighted, and was exercised, and my spirit swooned away.

segments.t: Rénuit consolári ánima mea, * memor fui Dei, et delectátus sum, et exercitátus sum: et defécit spíritus meus.

content.latin: 76:5 Anticipavérunt vigílias óculi mei: * turbátus sum, et non sum locútus.
content.english: 76:5 My eyes prevented the watches: * I was troubled, and I spoke not.

segments.t: Anticipavérunt vigílias óculi mei: * turbátus sum, et non sum locútus.

content.latin: 76:6 Cogitávi dies antíquos: * et annos ætérnos in mente hábui.
content.english: 76:6 I thought upon the days of old: * and I had in my mind the eternal years.

segments.t: Cogitávi dies antíquos: * et annos ætérnos in mente hábui.

content.latin: 76:7 Et meditátus sum nocte cum corde meo, * et exercitábar, et scopébam spíritum meum.
content.english: 76:7 And I meditated in the night with my own heart: * and I was exercised and I swept my spirit.

segments.t: Et meditátus sum nocte cum corde meo, * et exercitábar, et scopébam spíritum meum.

content.latin: 76:8 Numquid in ætérnum proíciet Deus: * aut non appónet ut complacítior sit adhuc?
content.english: 76:8 Will God then cast off for ever? * or will he never be more favourable again?

segments.t: Numquid in ætérnum proíciet Deus: * aut non appónet ut complacítior sit adhuc?

content.latin: 76:9 Aut in finem misericórdiam suam abscíndet, * a generatióne in generatiónem?
content.english: 76:9 Or will he cut off his mercy for ever, * from generation to generation?

segments.t: Aut in finem misericórdiam suam abscíndet, * a generatióne in generatiónem?

content.latin: 76:10 Aut obliviscétur miseréri Deus? * aut continébit in ira sua misericórdias suas?
content.english: 76:10 Or will God forget to shew mercy? * or will he in his anger shut up his mercies?

segments.t: Aut obliviscétur miseréri Deus? * aut continébit in ira sua misericórdias suas?

content.latin: 76:11 Et dixi: Nunc cœpi: * hæc mutátio déxteræ Excélsi.
content.english: 76:11 And I said, Now have I begun: * this is the change of the right hand of the most High.

segments.t: Et dixi: Nunc cœpi: * hæc mutátio déxteræ Excélsi.

content.latin: 76:12 Memor fui óperum Dómini: * quia memor ero ab inítio mirabílium tuórum.
content.english: 76:12 I remembered the works of the Lord: * for I will be mindful of thy wonders from the beginning.

segments.t: Memor fui óperum Dómini: * quia memor ero ab inítio mirabílium tuórum.

content.latin: 76:13 Et meditábor in ómnibus opéribus tuis: * et in adinventiónibus tuis exercébor.
content.english: 76:13 And I will meditate on all thy works: * and will be employed in thy inventions.

segments.t: Et meditábor in ómnibus opéribus tuis: * et in adinventiónibus tuis exercébor.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
content.english: ℣. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

segments.t: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.latin: ℟. Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
content.english: ℟. As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

segments.t: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
Psalmus 76(14-21)

content.latin: 76:14 Deus, in sancto via tua: quis Deus magnus sicut Deus noster? * tu es Deus qui facis mirabília.
content.english: 76:14 Thy way, O God, is in the holy place: who is the great God like our God? * Thou art the God that dost wonders.

segments.t: Deus, in sancto via tua: quis Deus magnus sicut Deus noster? * tu es Deus qui facis mirabília.

content.latin: 76:15 Notam fecísti in pópulis virtútem tuam: * redemísti in brácchio tuo pópulum tuum, fílios Iacob et Ioseph.
content.english: 76:15 Thou hast made thy power known among the nations: * with thy arm thou hast redeemed thy people, the children of Jacob and of Joseph.

segments.t: Notam fecísti in pópulis virtútem tuam: * redemísti in brácchio tuo pópulum tuum, fílios Iacob et Ioseph.

content.latin: 76:17 Vidérunt te aquæ, Deus, vidérunt te aquæ: * et timuérunt, et turbátæ sunt abýssi.
content.english: 76:17 The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee: * and they were afraid, and the depths were troubled.

segments.t: Vidérunt te aquæ, Deus, vidérunt te aquæ: * et timuérunt, et turbátæ sunt abýssi.

content.latin: 76:18 Multitúdo sónitus aquárum: * vocem dedérunt nubes.
content.english: 76:18 Great was the noise of the waters: * the clouds sent out a sound.

segments.t: Multitúdo sónitus aquárum: * vocem dedérunt nubes.

content.latin: 76:18 Étenim sagíttæ tuæ tránseunt: * vox tonítrui tui in rota.
content.english: 76:18 For thy arrows pass: * the voice of thy thunder in a wheel.

segments.t: Étenim sagíttæ tuæ tránseunt: * vox tonítrui tui in rota.

content.latin: 76:19 Illuxérunt coruscatiónes tuæ orbi terræ: * commóta est, et contrémuit terra.
content.english: 76:19 Thy lightnings enlightened the world: * the earth shook and trembled.

segments.t: Illuxérunt coruscatiónes tuæ orbi terræ: * commóta est, et contrémuit terra.

content.latin: 76:20 In mari via tua, et sémitæ tuæ in aquis multis: * et vestígia tua non cognoscéntur.
content.english: 76:20 Thy way is in the sea, and thy paths in many waters: * and thy footsteps shall not be known.

segments.t: In mari via tua, et sémitæ tuæ in aquis multis: * et vestígia tua non cognoscéntur.

content.latin: 76:21 Deduxísti sicut oves pópulum tuum, * in manu Móysi et Aaron.
content.english: 76:21 Thou hast conducted thy people like sheep, * by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

segments.t: Deduxísti sicut oves pópulum tuum, * in manu Móysi et Aaron.

content.latin: ℣. Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.

content.english: Psalm 85 [3]

segments.t: Psalmus 85

content.latin: 85:1 Inclína, Dómine, aurem tuam, et exáudi me: * quóniam inops, et pauper sum ego.
content.english: 85:1 Incline thy ear, O Lord, and hear me: * for I am needy and poor.

segments.t: Inclína, Dómine, aurem tuam, et exáudi me: * quóniam inops, et pauper sum ego.

content.latin: 85:2 Custódi ánimam meam, quóniam sanctus sum: * salvum fac servum tuum, Deus meus, sperántem in te.
content.english: 85:2 Preserve my soul, for I am holy: * save thy servant, O my God, that trusteth in thee.

segments.t: Custódi ánimam meam, quóniam sanctus sum: * salvum fac servum tuum, Deus meus, sperántem in te.

content.latin: 85:3 Miserére mei, Dómine, quóniam ad te clamávi tota die: * lætífica ánimam servi tui, quóniam ad te, Dómine, ánimam meam levávi.
content.english: 85:3 Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I have cried to thee all the day. * Give joy to the soul of thy servant, for to thee, O Lord, I have lifted up my soul.

segments.t: Miserére mei, Dómine, quóniam ad te clamávi tota die: * lætífica ánimam servi tui, quóniam ad te, Dómine, ánimam meam levávi.

content.latin: 85:5 Quóniam tu, Dómine, suávis, et mitis: * et multæ misericórdiæ ómnibus invocántibus te.
content.english: 85:5 For thou, O Lord, art sweet and mild: * and plenteous in mercy to all that call upon thee.

segments.t: Quóniam tu, Dómine, suávis, et mitis: * et multæ misericórdiæ ómnibus invocántibus te.

content.latin: 85:6 Áuribus pércipe, Dómine, oratiónem meam: * et inténde voci deprecatiónis meæ.
content.english: 85:6 Give ear, O Lord, to my prayer: * and attend to the voice of my petition.

segments.t: Áuribus pércipe, Dómine, oratiónem meam: * et inténde voci deprecatiónis meæ.

content.latin: 85:7 In die tribulatiónis meæ clamávi ad te: * quia exaudísti me.
content.english: 85:7 I have called upon thee in the day of my trouble: * because thou hast heard me.

segments.t: In die tribulatiónis meæ clamávi ad te: * quia exaudísti me.

content.latin: 85:8 Non est símilis tui in diis, Dómine: * et non est secúndum ópera tua.
content.english: 85:8 There is none among the gods like unto thee, O Lord: * and there is none according to thy works.

segments.t: Non est símilis tui in diis, Dómine: * et non est secúndum ópera tua.

content.latin: 85:9 Omnes gentes quascúmque fecísti, vénient, et adorábunt coram te, Dómine: * et glorificábunt nomen tuum.
content.english: 85:9 All the nations thou hast made shall come and adore before thee, O Lord: * and they shall glorify thy name.

segments.t: Omnes gentes quascúmque fecísti, vénient, et adorábunt coram te, Dómine: * et glorificábunt nomen tuum.

content.latin: 85:10 Quóniam magnus es tu, et fáciens mirabília: * tu es Deus solus.
content.english: 85:10 For thou art great and dost wonderful things: * thou art God alone.

segments.t: Quóniam magnus es tu, et fáciens mirabília: * tu es Deus solus.

content.latin: 85:11 Deduc me, Dómine, in via tua, et ingrédiar in veritáte tua: * lætétur cor meum ut tímeat nomen tuum.
content.english: 85:11 Conduct me, O Lord, in thy way, and I will walk in thy truth: * let my heart rejoice that it may fear thy name.

segments.t: Deduc me, Dómine, in via tua, et ingrédiar in veritáte tua: * lætétur cor meum ut tímeat nomen tuum.

content.latin: 85:12 Confitébor tibi, Dómine, Deus meus, in toto corde meo, * et glorificábo nomen tuum in ætérnum:
content.english: 85:12 I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with my whole heart, * and I will glorify thy name for ever:

segments.t: Confitébor tibi, Dómine, Deus meus, in toto corde meo, * et glorificábo nomen tuum in ætérnum:

content.latin: 85:13 Quia misericórdia tua magna est super me: * et eruísti ánimam meam ex inférno inferióri.
content.english: 85:13 For thy mercy is great towards me: * and thou hast delivered my soul out of the lower hell.

segments.t: Quia misericórdia tua magna est super me: * et eruísti ánimam meam ex inférno inferióri.

content.latin: 85:14 Deus, iníqui insurrexérunt super me, et synagóga poténtium quæsiérunt ánimam meam: * et non proposuérunt te in conspéctu suo.
content.english: 85:14 O God, the wicked are risen up against me, and the assembly of the mighty have sought my soul: * and they have not set thee before their eyes.

segments.t: Deus, iníqui insurrexérunt super me, et synagóga poténtium quæsiérunt ánimam meam: * et non proposuérunt te in conspéctu suo.

content.latin: 85:15 Et tu, Dómine, Deus miserátor et miséricors, * pátiens, et multæ misericórdiæ, et verax,
content.english: 85:15 And thou, O Lord, art a God of compassion, and merciful, * patient, and of much mercy, and true.

segments.t: Et tu, Dómine, Deus miserátor et miséricors, * pátiens, et multæ misericórdiæ, et verax,

content.latin: 85:16 Réspice in me, et miserére mei, * da impérium tuum púero tuo: et salvum fac fílium ancíllæ tuæ.
content.english: 85:16 O look upon me, and have mercy on me: * give thy command to thy servant, and save the son of thy handmaid.

segments.t: Réspice in me, et miserére mei, * da impérium tuum púero tuo: et salvum fac fílium ancíllæ tuæ.

content.latin: 85:17 Fac mecum signum in bonum, ut vídeant qui odérunt me, et confundántur: * quóniam tu, Dómine, adiuvísti me, et consolátus es me.
content.english: 85:17 Shew me a token for good: that they who hate me may see, and be confounded, * because thou, O Lord, hast helped me and hast comforted me.

segments.t: Fac mecum signum in bonum, ut vídeant qui odérunt me, et confundántur: * quóniam tu, Dómine, adiuvísti me, et consolátus es me.

content.latin: Te lucis ante términum,
content.english: Before the ending of the day,

content.latin: Rerum Creátor, póscimus,
content.english: Creator of the world, we pray

content.latin: Ut pro tua cleméntia
content.english: That with thy wonted favor thou

content.latin: Sis præsul et custódia.
content.english: Wouldst be our guard and keeper now.

content.latin: Procul recédant sómnia,
content.english: From all ill dreams defend our eyes,

content.latin: Et nóctium phantásmata;
content.english: From nightly fears and fantasies;

content.latin: Hostémque nostrum cómprime,
content.english: Tread under foot our ghostly foe,

content.latin: Ne polluántur córpora.
content.english: That no pollution we may know.

content.latin: Præsta, Pater piíssime,
content.english: O Father, that we ask be done,

content.latin: Patríque compar Únice,
content.english: Through Jesus Christ, thine only Son;

content.latin: Cum Spíritu Paráclito
content.english: Who, with the Holy Ghost and thee,

content.latin: Regnans per omne sǽculum.
content.english: Doth live and reign eternally.

content.english: Amen.

content.english: But thou, O Lord, art among us, and thy name is called upon by us: forsake us not, O Lord our God.

content.english: 2:29 Now thou dost dismiss thy servant, O Lord, ✠ * according to thy word in peace;

content.latin: 2:30 Quia vidérunt óculi mei * salutáre tuum,

content.english: ℣. O Lord, hear my prayer.

content.english: ℟. And let my cry come unto thee.

segments.t: Et clamor meus ad te véniat.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Vísita, quǽsumus, Dómine, habitatiónem istam, et omnes insídias inimíci ab ea longe repélle: Ángeli tui sancti hábitent in ea, qui nos in pace custódiant; et benedíctio tua sit super nos semper.
content.english: Visit, we beseech thee, O Lord, this dwelling, and drive far from it the snares of the enemy; let thy holy angels dwell herein to preserve us in peace, and let thy blessing be always upon us.

content.latin: Per Dóminum nostrum Iesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
content.english: Through Jesus Christ, thy Son our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.

content.latin: Benedictio. Benedícat et custódiat nos omnípotens et miséricors Dóminus, ✠ Pater, et Fílius, et Spíritus Sanctus.
content.english: Benediction. The almighty and merciful Lord, ✠ the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit, bless us and keep us.

segments.t: Benedictio.
Benedícat et custódiat nos omnípotens et miséricors Dóminus, ✠ Pater, et Fílius, et Spíritus Sanctus.

content.english: ℟. Amen.

content.latin: Salve, Regína, mater misericórdiæ;
content.english: Hail holy Queen, Mother of Mercy,

content.latin: vita, dulcédo et spes nóstra, salve.
content.english: our life, our sweetness, and our hope.

content.latin: Ad te clamámus éxsules fílii Hevæ.
content.english: To thee do we cry, poor banished children of Eve.

content.latin: Ad te suspirámus geméntes et flentes
content.english: To thee do we send up our sighs, mourning and weeping

content.latin: In hac lacrimárum valle.
content.english: In this valley of tears.

content.latin: Eia ergo, advocáta nostra,
content.english: Turn then, most gracious Advocate,

content.latin: illos tuos misericórdes óculos ad nos convérte.
content.english: thine eyes of mercy toward us.

content.latin: Et Iesum, benedíctum fructum ventris tui,
content.english: And after this our exile show unto us

content.latin: nobis post hoc exsílium osténde.
content.english: the blessed fruit of thy womb, Jesus.

content.latin: O clemens, o pia, o dulcis Virgo María.
content.english: O clement, O loving, O sweet Virgin Mary.

content.latin: ℣. Ora pro nobis, sancta Dei Génetrix.
content.english: ℣. Pray for us, O Holy Mother of God.

segments.t: Ora pro nobis, sancta Dei Génetrix.

content.latin: ℟. Ut digni efficiámur promissiónibus Christi.
content.english: ℟. That we may be made worthy of the promises of Christ.

segments.t: Ut digni efficiámur promissiónibus Christi.

content.latin: Orémus.
content.english: Let us pray.

content.latin: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui gloriósæ Vírginis Matris Maríæ corpus et ánimam, ut dignum Fílii tui habitáculum éffici mererétur, Spíritu Sancto cooperánte, præparásti: da, ut, cuius commemoratióne lætámur, eius pia intercessióne, ab instántibus malis et a morte perpétua liberémur. Per eúndem Christum Dóminum nostrum. Amen.
content.english: O almighty, everlasting God, who by the cooperation of the Holy Spirit, didst prepare the body and soul of Mary, glorious Virgin and Mother, to become a worthy dwelling for Thy Son; grant that we who rejoice in her commemoration may, by her gracious intercession, be delivered from present evils and from everlasting death. Through the same Christ our Lord. Amen.

content.latin: ℣. Divínum auxílium ✠ máneat semper nobíscum.
content.english: ℣. May the divine assistance ✠ remain with us always.

segments.t: Divínum auxílium ✠ máneat semper nobíscum.

content.latin: ℟. Amen.
content.english: ℟. Amen.

segments.t: Amen.
